script: Your headlamp dies, then the backup, then the third. The darkness is total. You can't see your hand. You crawl, feel a drop-off, and back away. Every tunnel feels the same. You're lost, and no one knows your route. Your breathing echoes. Hours pass, and your water runs out. You don't survive.
captions: Your headlamp dies, then the backup.
The third light flickers out.
The darkness is total.
Every tunnel feels the same.
No one knows your route. You don't survive.

title: Would you survive crossing a glacial river in the afternoon? #shorts
description: Glacial rivers can double in volume in a few hours, and the cold water can incapacitate swimmers in minutes. #shorts #survival #didyouknow #scary
hook: What would happen if you tried to cross a glacial river in the afternoon when the melt peaks?
script: The river was ankle deep this morning. By afternoon, the sun has melted tons of ice, and the water is thigh high and fast. You step in, and the current knocks you down. The ice-cold water steals your breath. You can't stand. Boulders grind beneath the surface. You don't survive.
captions: The river was ankle deep this morning.
The afternoon melt swells it.
You step in. The current knocks you down.
The icy water steals your breath.
You can't stand. You don't survive.
